purpose: Reader-facing chapter goals and key ideas printed by the continuous builder. Book-level apparatus; chapter sources and their review records are unchanged.

goals: separate stored structure, expressed computation and adapted structure, and say which intervention tests each
trace an exact typed expression example and compare it with its ordinary branching baseline
place DOGMA, Hermon DNA and Evolutor in the book's fixed taxonomy
count per-request memory for carried state and a key/value cache without mistaking the ratio for a speedup
key_ideas: Context changes test regulation; changes to the stored description test structural adaptation. Without an observable intervention, ``adaptive'' explains nothing.
An ordered plan carries information that a set of active modules cannot: \texttt{clip} then \texttt{prefix} differs from the reverse order.
Every idea in the chapter already has a conventional computer-science neighbour. A genomic proposal must name the property it adds and the comparison that would reveal it.
Physical DNA computing, genomic sequence modelling and biologically inspired digital organisation are three different subjects.

goals: distinguish data, task, model, objective and evaluation protocol
align next-base inputs and targets so that a causal mask actually prevents leakage
build relationship-aware splits by closing conflict relations before assigning folds
use the random-data entropy bound and finite future interventions as falsification instruments
key_ideas: For independent uniform targets, no permitted predictor can beat $\ln V$ in expectation. A sustained advantage on fresh data is a reason to audit the pipeline.
A triangular mask is only correct relative to a declared target shift. Padding, packing, pooling and retrieval can each leak information.
Report the summed negative log-likelihood and the number of raw bases it covers. Perplexities computed under different tokenizers are not comparable.
Parameter, width, state, token, compute and wall-time matching are separate choices. No single scalar removes every confound.

goals: read an equation as a tensor program with explicit shapes and broadcasts
derive softmax cross-entropy and affine-layer gradients by hand and check them against autograd
explain why finite-difference error first falls and then rises as the step shrinks
implement microbatch accumulation that reproduces the declared full-batch objective
key_ideas: A shared bias collects one gradient contribution from every row. Dividing that sum again by the batch size changes the update.
Forward equality is not gradient equality: \texttt{stop\_gradient} can preserve values while changing derivatives.
An exact gradient does not choose a safe step. On $\tfrac12\lambda x^2$, gradient descent converges only for $0<\eta<2/\lambda$.
Weight microbatch gradients by their scored-target counts, not by the number of microbatches.

goals: construct shifted, padded and masked next-base targets with an explicit denominator
inventory everything a training transition depends on: parameters, momentum, sampler cursor and random state
serialize and restore a checkpoint that resumes exactly in a declared environment
use deliberately incomplete restores as negative controls
key_ideas: A training run has more state than its weights. Momentum, the data cursor and the dropout random stream all determine the next update.
The token mean and the mean of group means are different objectives. Choose one deliberately and test it.
Training mode and gradient recording are independent switches: \texttt{no\_grad()} does not disable dropout.
Exact replay is scoped to a tested environment, not promised across devices or library versions.

goals: define a token by its base interval as well as its text
build fixed-width base-four codes and a model vocabulary that keeps every short tail
detect objectives in which overlapping tokens reveal part of their own target
transform spans and token boundaries under reverse complementation
key_ideas: An integer ID decodes only together with its declared width: ID 1 is \texttt{C} at width one and \texttt{AAC} at width three.
With stride-one $k$-mers, the next token contains only one unseen base. Conditional entropy is $\ln4$, not $k\ln4$.
Token boundaries are a software choice, not covalent breaks. Disjoint chunks do not commute with reverse complementation.
A checkpoint must carry the vocabulary identity. Equal table shapes can give embedding rows entirely different meanings.

goals: unroll a recurrence and derive the Jacobian product that governs long-range gradients
implement LSTM and GRU cells and check values and gradients against PyTorch
hold state through padding, reset it at record boundaries and carry it across chunks
separate the numerical value of carried state from its gradient history
key_ideas: $\partial h_T/\partial h_k$ is a product of Jacobians. Contraction loses the distant past and expansion amplifies it.
Gate names are conventions: PyTorch's GRU applies reset after the hidden projection, and the order changes the values.
Detaching keeps the boundary value but cuts credit assignment; resetting changes the forward computation itself.
A gate half-life in token steps is not a genomic distance until the tokenization fixes what a step means.

goals: derive zero-order-hold discretization and contrast it with an unstable Euler step
expand a time-invariant recurrence into a causal convolution
make updates input-selective while keeping them affine in the previous state
compose interval summaries with an associative scan and check it against the sequential recurrence
key_ideas: Affine maps $h\mapsto ah+b$ are closed under composition, and composition is associative. That closure is what makes a parallel scan legal.
Associativity permits regrouping, never reordering: $(0.5,1)\star(0.25,2)\ne(0.25,2)\star(0.5,1)$.
Padding is the identity pair $(1,0)$; a reset before the current write is $(0,b_t)$; a chunk boundary carries the actual state.
Logarithmic dependency depth describes a possible schedule. It is not a measured speedup.

goals: compute attention by hand, separating addressing (queries and keys) from content (values)
build packed causal masks that also respect record boundaries and padding
derive the attention backward pass, including $\partial o/\partial z_j=p_j(v_j-o)$
append to a key/value cache with offset masks and verify chunked--full parity
key_ideas: Masking must happen before normalization. Masking afterwards leaves the forbidden entry in the denominator.
An all-masked row has no probability distribution. Its output needs an explicit policy.
A cached chunk's queries sit at absolute positions. Applying a local triangular mask hides most of the available history.
An attention weight is not an attribution: the values, later projections and residual paths also determine the output.

goals: assemble a pre-normalized block from attention, LayerNorm, a GELU feed-forward branch and residual paths
derive the LayerNorm backward pass, including the role of $\epsilon$
add sinusoidal absolute positions and keep them consistent across cached chunks
count parameters by ownership and align next-token targets across records and padding
key_ideas: With both branches zeroed, a pre-normalized block returns its input exactly; a post-normalized block does not.
Normalization couples the features of one token, never positions or records. With $\epsilon>0$ it is shift-invariant but not exactly scale-invariant.
Each block owns its own cache. Equal shapes do not make block~1's keys usable by block~2.
The attention mask decides which inputs a prediction may see; the target mask decides which predictions are scored. Either can be wrong while the other is right.

goals: separate router scoring, top-1 selection, capacity admission and probability weighting
gather admitted rows to experts and scatter results back, verified against a dense all-expert oracle
derive which gradients exist for a fixed routing decision, and which do not
account for demand, overflow, unused slots and multiply--accumulate counts
key_ideas: A capacity budget is not balanced demand. With demand $(3,2,1)$ and two slots per expert, one token is dropped while a slot stays empty.
Renormalizing over a single selected expert makes the gate identically one and erases the router's task-loss gradient.
Capacity counters are state: resetting them at a chunk boundary changes which tokens are admitted.
Compare routed arithmetic with the original dense layer, not with an all-expert oracle. Here the routed version does more work.

goals: normalize promoter-state weights and distinguish active occupancy from fold change
solve two-stage RNA/protein dynamics exactly over a constant-input interval
show that history, not present context alone, determines abundance
identify a structural non-identifiability in protein-only observations
key_ideas: At $u=0.2$, $r=1$ the active probability is $1/11$ while the fold change is $6/11$. These are different quantities.
Protein can keep rising after transcription stops, because surviving RNA continues to be translated.
Scaling $s\to s/c$ and $k\to ck$ leaves every protein trajectory unchanged. Better protein data cannot separate these parameter sets; RNA data or an intervention can.
Expert routing (Chapter~10) is instantaneous selection. Regulation here is stateful production with turnover. Calling both ``regulation'' does not make them the same.

goals: separate a stored specification, its construction procedure, the generated graph and its execution
implement simultaneous rewriting and derive its exponential growth
compile a recursive residual module into a typed, topologically ordered program
show that shared parameters accumulate gradients from every occurrence
key_ideas: A short rule need not give a small realization: $S\mapsto SG$, $G\mapsto GG$ doubles the word every generation.
Type validity is necessary but not sufficient. Adding the wrong width-$D$ value passes every check and computes the wrong function.
Sharing reduces stored parameters, not executed work. At depth six both policies run 1024 MACs per row.
Initially equal independent owners and one shared owner are different training systems once the first update is applied.

goals: distinguish state updates, parameter learning, structural proposals and population selection
derive closed-form oracles for gradient descent on a two-feature problem
run a deterministic elitist mask search with an explicit lineage
state an inheritance map and account for validation reuse during search
key_ideas: When two features agree in training, perfect training fit cannot identify the robust one. Only a validation set that breaks the agreement can.
Inheritance is a mapping, not a file copy. Newly enabled coordinates start from a declared value and stale weights are cleared.
A validation set that guides selection is part of the search, not an untouched test. With 20 independent null candidates at $\alpha=0.05$, the chance of at least one false positive is about 0.64.
In evaluator-driven program evolution the evaluator is part of the specification, and a candidate can exploit its gaps.

goals: define tensor types with semantic axis names, sizes and element type
specify computational genes, genomes and explicit regulator decisions
type-check a genome as an environment transformation before any arithmetic
execute one expression step with snapshot reads and an atomic commit
key_ideas: Two $2\times2$ arrays can be incompatible: \texttt{(sample, feature)} is not \texttt{(feature, sample)}.
A disabled gene follows a declared identity bypass, and it must still be valid.
Value names are single-assignment. State ownership is a separate constraint, with one writer per state owner.
A compact trace is not a replay record. Replay needs content identities for the genome, inputs, parameters, initial state and decisions.

goals: define configurations, events and a small-step relation for a register machine
prove a loop correct with an invariant and terminating with a ranking function
separate fuel exhaustion, explicit halt and runtime error
state when two state updates commute, and replay a trace to check a claimed execution
key_ideas: Types alone do not preserve a computation. Swapping \texttt{add} and \texttt{dec} keeps every type and gives $N(N-1)/2$ instead of $N(N+1)/2$.
Running out of fuel does not prove divergence: one step too little fuel also exhausts.
Disjoint read and write sets are sufficient for two updates to commute, but not necessary.
Replay recomputes each event from a trusted program and start state. A valid prefix does not prove completion, and an unauthenticated trace proves nothing about its producer.

goals: treat cost as a vector with units: parameters, MACs, routing, bytes, peak memory and events
derive expert-routing ledgers with and without padding and capacity drops
compute peak live memory for a schedule and show that legal schedules differ
prove an amortized bound with a potential function and place a design under a roofline envelope
key_ideas: Sparse routing can execute more arithmetic than its useful work. With padded capacity, four times as many expert MACs run as are needed.
Peak memory is a maximum over live sets, not a sum; the order $a,c,b,d,y$ lowers the peak from 300 to 210 bytes.
An amortized cost of three per append is not a latency bound. The append that triggers a resize still copies every element.
A roofline is a lower bound on time under stated ceilings. It is a hypothesis to measure, not a performance result.

goals: distinguish traces, gradients, credit allocations and interventions
implement structural interventions that recompute descendants
expose redundancy and synergy with complete response tables
compute exact Shapley credit and see what it hides
key_ideas: A bystander can predict perfectly on observations and fail every intervention: $\hat y=5z$ fits until $z$ is set directly.
Single ablations cannot separate OR from AND. Both give Shapley credit $(\tfrac12,\tfrac12)$ despite opposite interaction signs.
Editing a logged value is not an intervention. The declared equation must be replaced and its descendants recomputed.
In a linear recurrence a patched input decays as $\lambda^{t-k}$. In nonlinear systems, gradients and finite counterfactuals can disagree.

goals: define a DNA-addressed state primitive with ordered-pair channels
separate padding identity, record reset and zero retention
prove reverse-complement equivariance of the unit-retention histogram and construct its failure under decay
show by construction that a fixed state can discard order information
key_ideas: Addresses are ordered: G followed by A selects GA, not AG.
Equivariance means features transform by a known permutation; invariance means they do not change. Strand-specific labels need the first.
With retention below one, reversing orientation changes each pair's age and breaks the symmetry. Averaging both orientations repairs it, but it reads the whole record.
AACA and ACAA have identical final states, so no output head can tell them apart. Training cannot recover discarded information.

goals: derive a bounded selective update from separate write and retention gates
use the Chapter~18 collision as a constructive test of order sensitivity
prove causality and chunk equivalence for input-only coefficients
show how a state-dependent gate breaks both contraction and the affine scan
key_ideas: A write gate reweights the retained state as well as the candidate: $a=1-g(1-\rho)$.
Convex updates keep every coordinate within the range of its inputs. A bounded state is not the same as a contraction.
Once a gate reads $h_{t-1}$, its coefficients cannot be prepared from tokens alone, and the scan theorem no longer applies.
$(g,\rho)=(\tfrac12,\tfrac12)$ and $(\tfrac34,\tfrac23)$ give the same forward map. Fitting outputs cannot identify the gates separately.

goals: derive retention from a declared clock and convert it to e-fold time and half-life
build a multiscale exponential bank and a block-rate coarse summary
identify the complete carried state needed for exact chunk parity
prove limits on lossless memory with an aliasing example and a counting argument
key_ideas: Longer retention trades immediate write amplitude for persistence: at $a=7/8$, a fresh input moves the state by only $1/8$.
Slow updating is not slow retention. A block commit is constant between commits and has different gradient paths from a per-token exponential.
Dropping the pending sum and phase at a chunk boundary silently changes the model.
With $C$ bits of state and $2n>C$, two distinct DNA strings of length $n$ must share a state, so no fixed-size state stores every history.

goals: express reverse complementation as position reversal composed with a channel permutation
choose the output action (invariant, equivariant or label-swapping) that a task requires
lift a shared causal operator into a paired dual-direction state and prove its transformation law
prove that exact reversal symmetry and left causality together eliminate nonlocal context
key_ideas: The paired strand of $5'$-ACGA-$3'$, read $5'$ to $3'$, is TCGT. Complementing alone describes a different reading.
A readout preserves the symmetry only if its blocks are tied: $\left(\begin{smallmatrix}U&V\\V&U\end{smallmatrix}\right)$.
The aligned reverse branch reads the suffix, so the dual representation is offline by construction.
Reverse complementation reverses chunk order as well as each chunk. Transforming chunks in arrival order gives a different record.

goals: freeze a small reference DOGMA with explicit ownership of fast state and memory loci
trace one transition by hand and use it to detect read-before-write errors
separate causal streaming from offline strand-symmetric encoding
state ablations and a falsification matrix that could reject each DOGMA hypothesis
key_ideas: Reads use $M_{t-1}$ before the write at $t$. The assigned trace's first feature is $\tanh(1/4)$, not $\tanh(1/4+1/5)$.
Bounded state is a forward invariant, not a gradient guarantee: state-dependent gates add Jacobian terms.

Read the pilot honestly: on 128 balanced held-out records, a single run's accuracy has a chance-level standard error of about $0.044$. Most learned models in this budget sit within two standard errors of $0.5$.
If loci, strand tying and typed traces add nothing after budget matching, DOGMA should collapse toward a GRU or SSM. That would be a useful result.

goals: specify the Hermon DNA reference as a pre-norm Transformer over single nucleotides
trace one attention head by hand and check attention against an independent row oracle
separate offline and causal masks from padding, and build a shared-parameter reverse-complement-invariant head
read a small trained pilot correctly, including a model that fails to learn
key_ideas: An all-masked row has no softmax. The reference assigns it zero attention and zero output as an explicit padding convention.
Reverse-complement invariance follows from an involution on the sequence-and-mask pair. Reversing the sequence without its validity mask breaks it.
Dense attention keeps $BHT^2$ scores per layer. Doubling $T$ quadruples that term, which is why long genomic context needs a different access pattern.
In the 25-epoch pilot, Hermon's training loss stays at $\ln2$ and its held-out accuracy equals the random-label control. A correct implementation is not a trained model.

goals: give every token a base span and compute exact mutation footprints
state span-level causality: a token containing the target base is illegal context
build a tied strand embedding with an exact reverse-complement action
derive rotary positions in base units and express long-context access as an attention graph with layer-counted paths
key_ideas: A triangular token mask cannot remove information already inside a token: ACG over $[0,3)$ contains the base it would predict.
Equivariant input features do not make a model equivariant. Every later layer must commute with the same action.
Rotary scores depend only on relative position, but that algebra is not evidence of length extrapolation.
A global relay needs two layers. Sparse semantics implemented with dense masked scores still uses dense memory.

goals: state an estimand before comparing DOGMA, Hermon DNA or baselines
close leakage relations transitively with union--find and audit the split
select preprocessing and thresholds from training data only
quantify paired and cluster-level uncertainty and keep seed variance separate
key_ideas: A shared experiment envelope fixes the question and the evidence. It need not give the models a shared internal state.
Reverse complements, group tags and curated links can chain together. The whole connected component must stay in one split.
Keep both predictions attached to each resampled unit. With four perfectly correlated clusters, the honest interval is $[-1,1]$, not the narrow row-level one.
A test-set bootstrap conditional on one fitted pair says nothing about variation across training seeds.

goals: derive chronological affine composition and check associativity with an independent matrix oracle
build an inclusive Hillis--Steele scan and fold resets and padding into effective pairs
carry chunk state without cutting its gradient, and derive a reverse-mode adjoint oracle
exhibit a real floating-point counterexample to unrestricted scan parity
key_ideas: The left operand happens first: $(2,1)\otimes(3,4)=(6,7)$, while the reversed order gives $(6,9)$.
Padding is $(\mathbf1,\mathbf0)$ and reset-before-update is $(\mathbf0,a_t h_{\rm reset}+b_t)$. Setting padded coefficients to zero erases the state.
Detaching a chunk boundary keeps forward values and changes gradients, so forward parity cannot establish training parity.
In float64, $(10^{16},-10^{16},1)$ sums to 1 sequentially and to 0 under the scan's regrouping. State the tolerance and workload for any parity claim.

goals: separate persistent array inventories from peak memory
accumulate weighted microbatch numerators against one global denominator
check Adam's moments, bias-correction clock and updated parameters, not only gradients
use activation checkpointing without changing stochastic behaviour
key_ideas: Dividing each microbatch by its own mass and averaging changes the objective. In the fixture the gradient error is about $0.14$.
The optimizer clock advances once per complete update. Stepping after each microbatch is a different algorithm.
Clipping is nonlinear: clipping $2$ and $-1.5$ separately at one gives $0$, but clipping their sum gives $0.5$.
Checkpointing without preserving the random state gives an identical forward loss and a wrong backward pass.

goals: declare ownership of data, parameters, gradients and optimizer state before choosing a parallelism strategy
derive one global weighted objective and its collective scaling
shard arrays with explicit ranks, offsets and empty owners, and derive tensor-parallel operators
pin, validate and reload a model artifact from raw bytes in a fresh process
key_ideas: Average rank numerators against the global mass. Averaging rank-local means, or dropping an empty rank, gives the wrong gradient.
A contraction-axis split combines partial outputs by summation; an output-axis split combines them by concatenation. A replicated bias is added once.
Persistent $1/D$ storage is not $1/D$ peak memory, because gathered parameters, activations and buffers remain.
A hash detects change only relative to a trusted pin. A coherent forgery with a matching manifest passes any check that lacks one.

goals: freeze a falsifiable comparative claim before ranking models
compute paired accuracy differences with an exact bootstrap oracle and a conditional sign test
resample crossed seed and group dimensions, and recognize pseudoreplication
gate resource budgets coordinate by coordinate and design ablation, transplant and sham interventions
key_ideas: A benchmark is a measurement instrument, not a verdict on an architecture.
Two hundred duplicated windows from two independent groups are still two experimental units. A naive i.i.d. standard error is fourteen times too small here.
Task selection alone can reverse a ranking: A wins task one, while B wins the equal-weight two-task suite.
A matched sham separates a mechanism's effect from extra work, and a GC-matched pair rules out a composition shortcut.

goals: bind a request to tenant, pinned model identity, deadline and independent output ceilings before allocating state
separate lifecycle phase, terminal reason and cleanup
arbitrate one terminal winner and fence late results with generation-stamped leases
reserve output capacity before launching work, and reconcile work and output counters
key_ideas: Completion, cancellation and failure race; the serialized terminal transition is the linearization point. At the deadline itself, the deadline wins.
Cancelling is not preemption. A buffer still referenced by in-flight work cannot be reused until its completion is acknowledged.
Generation numbers defeat ABA reuse: a stale lease must not write into a new tenant's allocation that has the same slot name.
$L=S+P$ and $G=Q+D+X$ are invariants. A missing acknowledgement or a silent queue loss breaks one of them visibly.

goals: bind native state to tenant, request, content-addressed artifact and position
derive and hand-check an input-gated diagonal recurrence step
ingest masked chunks with full preflight, and verify a closed form and its derivative independently
stage a decode step so that cancellation cannot advance native state
key_ideas: This is a restricted teaching recurrence, not full DOGMA. Its input-only gate is exactly what makes the closed form possible.
A frozen dataclass does not freeze tensor storage, so the oracle rechecks the artifact digest at every step.
Masking holds state and position; it is not a reset. A new request needs a fresh state and owner.
\texttt{detach()} keeps values but cuts gradients and still shares storage. An independent snapshot needs an explicit copy.

goals: separate logical state identity from physical slot residency
use generations to reject handles after reuse and versions to reject lost updates
pin in-flight work and defer reclamation until every pin is acknowledged
clone by value, bridge to native state, and state an honest scrubbing threat model
key_ideas: Generation answers ``is this still the same allocation?''; version answers ``was the result computed from the current payload?'' Neither substitutes for the other.
Release under a live pin marks the slot retiring. It is still occupied, so capacity is free $+$ owned $+$ retiring.
Clone-by-copy is the semantic oracle that any later copy-on-write optimization must refine.
Writing zeros clears what the API exposes. It is not cryptographic erasure of Python heap, VRAM or crash dumps.

goals: cut a computation at a semantic token boundary and prove continuation equivalence
bound checkpoint approximation error for a contracting recurrence
separate byte integrity, structural compatibility and replay consistency in a bounded data-only envelope
restore into fresh owners, look up the longest validated prefix and count checkpoint storage
key_ideas: Tensor equality is not state sufficiency: two snapshots with equal $h$ can continue differently if a phase or clock is missing.
A rehashed forgery passes the integrity and schema checks. Only replay or trusted provenance detects it.
Restore allocates a new owner; it never revives a stale handle. Branches own copied values, so evicting the source cannot break them.
Fixed-width state does not make a prefix cache constant-memory. Storing each complete prefix grows quadratically when $B=1$.

goals: lift one native transition to independent batch rows and prove permutation legality
implement inactivity as an identity, not as a zero token
separate scheduler ticks from request-local token clocks and gather and scatter through fenced lanes
bound numerical divergence and count bytes before claiming a kernel speedup
key_ideas: Row independence must be established. Batch normalization, batch-wide top-$k$ or shared random streams break it.
Masking must happen before the embedding lookup. Feeding token zero to an inactive lane still decays its state and advances its clock.
Each lane's acceptance is fenced separately: a cancelled lane rejects its result while a sibling commits. A batch is not a cross-request transaction.
Staging adds $4BDb$ bytes and roughly halves arithmetic intensity in the worked example. These are modelled bytes, not a roofline measurement.

goals: locate the state a causal Hermon DNA Transformer must retain: per-layer normalized keys and values
derive prefill and offset-masked chunk continuation for the actual two-layer reference
prove full/cached equivalence through the complete stack by induction over layers and chunks
count resident KV payload separately from the quadratic cost of repeated copying
key_ideas: Later-layer keys and values depend on earlier attention, residuals and feed-forward layers. Caching first-layer projections for every layer is wrong.
A continuation query sits at absolute position $t+i$. PyTorch's upper-left causal shortcut is shape-correct and semantically wrong here.
Learned absolute positions do not admit a rotary-style shift identity. Restarting the ordinal changes every layer.
Resident KV grows linearly ($384$\,MiB at $t=4096$ in the large example), but copying the prefix on every append costs $2\gamma GP+\gamma G(G-1)$.

goals: translate logical token ordinals to physical pages through a block table
conserve generational references and reference counts across fork, append and release
copy-on-write a shared partial tail and preflight every page before publishing
measure physical utilization and logical multiplicity separately
key_ideas: Flattening the pages must reproduce the Chapter~35 cache exactly. Physical page IDs may change; logical order may not.
Reference counts carry lifetime and generations carry identity, but authorization still needs owner checks.
Writing into a shared partial tail through a shared pointer would rewrite another request's history.
Shared pages can push logical multiplicity above one, as in the $7/6$ example. Physical utilization never exceeds one.

goals: separate consumed positions from emitted outputs
reserve page credits at admission and prove the arena cannot overflow
plan decode-first, chunked-prefill iterations under a token-work budget, and report TTFT, ITL and throughput in their own units
attach precision to tensor roles and bound how KV error propagates into one attention head
key_ideas: $O$ outputs need $P+O-1$ consumed positions: the last prompt row already emits the first output.
A token budget bounds counted tokens, not milliseconds. One prompt token and one decode token can cost very different amounts.
A one-output request has no inter-token latency sample. That is undefined, not zero.
A small maximum logit error preserves an argmax only when the margin exceeds twice the error. Near-ties need explicit negative controls.

goals: derive the modified rejection sampler and prove it emits the target law
extend it across blocks of conditional proposals with tentative KV ownership
separate expected acceptance from speed
derive the online-softmax merge and preserve offset causality across tiles and pages
key_ideas: After rejection, sample from the normalized residual $(p-q)_+$. Resampling from $p$ itself gives token zero probability $.505$ instead of $.55$.
Expected acceptance is $1-\mathrm{TV}(p,q)$, a statement about overlap. It says nothing about draft cost or latency.
Only the accepted contiguous prefix is reusable. Descendants of a rejected proposal were conditioned on a history that never happened.
When a larger maximum arrives, the online merge must rescale the old value accumulator as well as the normalizer.

goals: represent a heterogeneous workflow as a typed, single-assignment plan and validate it before any effect
separate planning from routing, and route on semantic capability before cost
address engine state through opaque, owner-bound handles
separate planned, authorized and completed tool effects, and trace execution without claiming hidden reasoning
key_ideas: Equal token IDs do not make two engines' inputs or logits comparable. Each backend is checked against its own oracle.
A fallback is legal only if it preserves the observable contract. Otherwise the planner must make a new plan and record the change.
Retrieved text is evidence, never a grant. Authorization comes only from configured policy, checked immediately before the effect.
If the effect succeeds but its receipt fails, completion is uncertain, and blind retry can repeat a non-idempotent action.

goals: distinguish engine-native state, durable events, lossy summaries and addressable records
define availability so that expiry and deletion propagate through a provenance DAG
witness exact information loss with a compression collision
bound rehydration and working-context promotion, and keep memory outside the authority boundary
key_ideas: A summary is available only if every ancestor is. A stale index entry cannot bring back a tombstoned source.
If two histories compress to the same text, no function of that text can recover which one occurred; only retained sources can.
UTF-8 bytes are not tokens, and a payload ratio is not total storage cost.
A tombstone denies future reads. It cannot recall a context already handed to a client or a running model.

goals: express a plan as a verified straight-line SSA IR with declared effects
define the observation a compiler pass must preserve
prove constant folding and dead-code elimination correct and test them against an independent oracle
lower to eligible implementations and plan peak live storage at allocation time
key_ideas: A producer cannot declare a tool or engine pure to unlock optimization. The verifier computes the expected effects for each kind.
Only total, deterministic pure operations may disappear. An unused tool or retrieval stays, because its effect is observable.
Floating-point reassociation is outside these proofs: $(10^{16}-10^{16})+1$ and $10^{16}+(-10^{16}+1)$ can differ.
Peak pressure occurs while an output is allocated, before its operands die, so $c=a+b$ needs three live values.

goals: separate a logical observation contract from its legal physical alternatives
transfer Volcano and Cascades structure without importing relational equivalence
attach object-specific validity to buffer management and transactions
derive a committed-redo-only write-ahead recovery contract and test it at every crash cut
key_ideas: Legality is a filter, not a cost penalty. The cheapest candidate here is ineligible.
Pins protect physical lifetime, not logical validity. A pinned buffer with the wrong artifact is still wrong.
A page write must cite a durable log record for the same key and value that does not regress the page's LSN. An LSN that certifies nothing specific certifies nothing.
Recovery restores durable metadata; replay reproduces execution observations. Neither reverses an external effect.

goals: name exactly which object a proposed adaptation changes and record immutable lineage
evaluate candidates with conjunctive gates bound to protocol, data and budget
contrast a parametric stability penalty (EWC) with structural legality checks
promote and roll back under role separation, revision guards and state compatibility
key_ideas: A large quality gain cannot buy back a failed safety gate. Eligibility is a conjunction.
Zero errors in 20 independent canary trials still allows a failure rate up to about $13.9\%$ at one-sided 95\%.
Rollback is a governed switch to a previously served, validated artifact. It is not time reversal and cannot undo external effects.
Equal tensor shapes do not make native state compatible. Carrying state across artifacts needs a verified conversion or a reset.

goals: bind model, runtime, configuration, interpretation contracts and provenance into one release identity
verify delivered bytes against an independently trusted manifest pin
separate liveness, readiness and the ability to reserve capacity, and drain by ownership conservation
observe without copying private content and turn observations into a falsifiable SLO with an error budget
key_ideas: Changing only the tokenizer must change the release digest. Interpretation is part of identity.
All hashes matching does not mean authenticated: an attacker who can replace the trust pin defeats byte consistency.
Promotion evidence must come from the candidate's own observations. The old revision's healthy history certifies nothing about the new one.
Accepted-only latency improves when you reject hard requests. Declare how rejections, timeouts and cancellations count.

goals: name the adversary and the trusted components before claiming isolation
take identity from authentication and authorize deny-by-default against an epoch-versioned grant set
issue capabilities with scope, session and expiry, and extend tenant namespaces through every stateful resource
reserve every resource dimension before allocating, and keep untrusted text away from tool authority
key_ideas: ``I am the administrator'' inside a prompt changes neither the principal nor the grant set.
Unescaped concatenation can make $(\texttt{A|B},\texttt{C})$ and $(\texttt{A},\texttt{B|C})$ hash identically. A hash cannot repair an ambiguous encoding.
The logical noninterference proof covers values only. A shared global quota already lets one tenant change another's admission.
A system prompt guides behaviour; it is not access control. A deterministic check must gate the effect.

goals: separate the control plane from the data plane, and routing from placement
represent state identity independently of location with an owner and a fencing epoch
migrate from a stable snapshot through prepare, copy, verify and commit, and prove at most one owner in the serial model
reserve paired prefill and decode capacity and estimate state-transfer cost
key_ideas: Copying bytes does not move authority. Only the directory transition from epoch $e$ to $e+1$ does, and it fences the old owner.
Lease expiry on local clocks does not stop a paused old worker. Fencing must be enforced where the mutation is accepted.
Reserve both pools before starting prefill. Otherwise prefill can produce state with no admitted destination.
Replaying internal model state does not deduplicate external effects.

goals: establish correctness parity before any timing comparison
freeze a workload, an arrival process and a measurement population
derive TTFT, ITL, goodput and nearest-rank percentiles from a single observation clock
find the critical path, apply Amdahl's model and state roofline ceilings at a named memory boundary
key_ideas: A failed request with no output has no TTFT sample. Dropping it from the denominator creates survivor bias.
A maximum-gap SLO is stricter than mean TPOT: gaps $(1,99)$ average 50 but fail a 60\,ms bound.
Parallel spans are not additive. Halving the off-path retrieval changes nothing; halving prefill makes retrieval critical.
One-query decode attention has intensity about $2/b$ FLOP/byte whatever the context length.

goals: turn a biological question into an observation contract: inputs, target, sampling unit and metric
close leakage relations (overlap and declared homology) transitively before splitting
transform sequences, coordinates and labels consistently under reverse complementation
report discrimination and probability metrics with declared tie and undefined-value policies, and keep variant scores separate from mechanisms
key_ideas: Windows $[0,100)$ and $[80,180)$ share evidence. A random window split tests a partly seen locus, not an unseen one.
CG is its own reverse complement, so it cannot test two orientations. Use ACG and CGT.
At 1\% prevalence, an all-negative classifier has 99\% accuracy, zero recall and undefined MCC.
Saliency and in-silico mutation measure a predictor's sensitivity. Showing that a protein binds a sequence in a cell needs a designed experiment, which this book does not perform.

goals: order events within a session and bound queues with visible rejection
keep native state, active context, durable memory and external state distinct
bind replay to identity and contract with a prefix digest
run a recovery state machine that records intent before dispatch and reconciles ambiguous crashes
key_ideas: A larger queue cannot fix a sustained arrival rate above the service rate; it only delays exhaustion.
The event log is not an engine checkpoint. Native carry and per-layer K/V each need their own artifact-bound state.
At most one local dispatch per key is not exactly-once external execution. A crash after intent requires reconciliation, not blind retry.
Replay reduces recorded observations into derived state. It never re-runs tools.

goals: separate context, memory, parameter, structural and population updates
derive acquisition, forgetting and an anchored compromise in a transparent quadratic
read the full experience matrix with a declared forgetting convention and backward transfer
count population-search opportunities and apply feasibility before Pareto selection
key_ideas: Sequential training on $(1,0)$ then $(0,1)$ ends at $(15/256,15/16)$: the objective forgets by construction.
Anchoring trades acquisition for retention and increases curvature, which tightens the stable learning-rate bound.
Last-task forgetting is zero by definition. That is not evidence of long-term retention.
A parent's score does not validate its mutations. Offspring are new candidates and need their own evaluation.

goals: separate evidence labels, from speculative to replicated, from performance numbers
treat breadth, depth and autonomy as separate dimensions of a capability vector
design unknown-task evaluation behind an information firewall, and report acquisition along a budget axis
prove that finite tests cannot establish unrestricted generality, and quantify what they can bound
key_ideas: A component inventory is not a capability argument. Memory, tools and self-editing name mechanisms, not demonstrated skills.
Autonomy is not a multiplier that converts narrow skill into breadth.
Two systems can agree on every observed history and differ on an unobserved one. Evidence supports scoped claims under assumptions, never universal competence.
This book demonstrates executable evidence contracts and falsifiable hypotheses. It demonstrates no AGI capability.

goals: state what is implemented and what remains a research claim for DOGMA, Hermon DNA and Evolutor
preserve the closest competitor in every evidence matrix
turn a symptom into a durable failure artifact and keep it after resolution
bind results to a dependency-closed capsule and state open problems as disconfirming experiments
key_ideas: A correct kernel does not prove a learning hypothesis, and a predictive gain does not validate a biological analogy.
A finite empirical loss can fall below $\log V$ by chance. The bound concerns an expectation under independence.
A resolution adds evidence; it never deletes the original counterexample.
Implementation, integration, independent review and publication are separate gates and must not be collapsed into one percentage.
